verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance automation platform with built-in AI features (AI Editor, Sprinto AI evidence analysis), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never shows it connecting to or using tools from external MCP servers. Its native integrations (Jira, ClickUp, JumpCloud), inbound webhooks, and the compliance-skills package installed into other agents are adjacent features, not MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
